北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京的朋友，阳光正好，微风舒适，体感稍凉，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's sunny and breezy. Feels a bit cool, remember to add a layer!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感凉爽，微风送爽。出门别忘带件外套！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast, feels cool and breezy. Don't forget a jacket when you go out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，气温适宜，体感微凉，轻风拂面，早晚注意温差。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, mild but feels a bit cool. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感闷热，湿度较大，注意防暑降温，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, feels muggy with high humidity. Stay cool and hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感较热，湿度偏高，注意防潮，保持身体舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels warm with high humidity. Stay comfortable and dry!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，气温舒适，体感宜人。湿度较低，多喝水润润喉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, temperatures are pleasant and comfortable. Low humidity, drink more water!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力较大，体感偏凉。出门防风保暖，注意安全哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and quite windy, feels chilly. Stay warm and safe outdoors!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温适中，体感舒适。湿度稍高，保持心情愉快！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, temperatures are moderate and comfortable. Slightly high humidity, keep a cheerful mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感微凉，湿度适中。出行记得带伞，以防不时之需。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast, feels slightly cool with moderate humidity. Remember your umbrella, just in case!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感偏凉，湿度较高。注意保暖，小心着凉感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels quite cool with high humidity. Stay warm and watch out for colds.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感温暖舒适，湿度适中。享受美好的一天吧！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels warm and comfortable with moderate humidity. Enjoy your day!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨风大，体感寒冷！请务必多穿衣物，小心防风保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is very windy and feels freezing! Please bundle up and stay warm against the wind.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，风力适中，体感凉爽。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with moderate wind, feels cool. Big temperature difference, remember to add layers.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感舒适，微风阵阵。湿度不高，记得多喝水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels comfortable with occasional breezes. Low humidity, remember to drink more water.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雨，体感稍凉，路面湿滑。出门带伞，注意出行安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has rain, feels a bit cool, roads are slippery. Bring an umbrella and drive safely.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感寒凉，风力较大。湿度高，注意防潮防湿。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast, feels cold and quite windy. High humidity, watch out for dampness.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感微凉，气温适中。注意早晚温差，穿衣保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels slightly cool, temperatures are moderate. Mind the morning/evening temperature difference.
